resources.string: "Average smoothing algorithm, newest value is not affected"
"No smoothing performed on input glucose data. Use this when you already have filtered data e.g. from BYODA G6."

"Unscented Kalman Filter smoothing with adaptive noise estimation and RTS backward smoother. G7 users: select this and leave the first-day toggle off — UKF runs always. G6 users: select this and enable the First-day CGM smoothing toggle in SmartInsulin → STFT settings — UKF runs for the first 24 h of each new sensor only, then automatically passes raw values through (identical to No Smoothing). Sensor swaps are detected automatically."
